title: Understanding the Scatterplot
text: Observe the scatterplot carefully. Notice the symmetry of the points around the y-axis. This symmetry can give you a clue about which function might fit the data.

title: Considering Absolute Value
text: The function $$f(x)=|x|$$, or absolute value, creates a V-shape which can fit data that is symmetric around the y-axis. Does this match the pattern you see in the scatterplot?

title: Checking the Fit
text: Would the function $$f(x)=|x|$$ allow you to choose scalars β0, β1, and β2 such that the model $$y_i=beta0+x_i beta1+f{\left(x_i\right)} beta2$$ holds for every data pair in the dataset?
